rows.before: guarded by `if (firstBlock)` — selection silently stayed on previous file when user clicked an empty file
rows.after: always calls setSelected; uses firstBlock?.id ?? '' so clicking an empty file deselects whatever was purple before
rows.reason: Tyler observed `msg.ofs` stayed selected in purple even after clicking elsewhere in the tree. Root cause: the firstBlock guard skipped selection updates for empty/no-block files.

rows.before: On mount, pre-selected files[0] (= 2d/inputmagic/msg.ofs), forced it expanded, expanded every ancestor directory
rows.after: No pre-selection on mount; user picks what they want to view
rows.reason: Tyler observed `msg.ofs` expanded by default and `2d/inputmagic/` auto-expanded. Root cause: the lookup-load handler auto-selected files[0] which is the very first file in the lookup.

rows.before: tree-file-btn rendered with no depth-aware padding; nested files visually appeared at root indent regardless of parent dir depth
rows.after: Threaded `depth` prop through TreeDirRow → TreeFileRow → tree-file-btn paddingLeft = 10 + depth*12 (matches dir indentation)
rows.reason: Tyler observed `inputmagic/` appeared empty because the file inside it (msg.ofs) was rendering at root indent, making the dir look like an empty leaf.
